title: Doom Patrol #10 DC 1988 Superman vs Metallo Erik Larsen Cover Kupperberg
conditionDescription: Bright cover with light handling wear; back cover has light edge wear and a small spot. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Doom Patrol #10 (July 1988), DC Comics - "Metallo has trashed the Doom Patrol!" Superman guest-stars. Paul Kupperberg, Erik Larsen and Martin; Erik Larsen cover. Superman 50th anniversary corner box. $1.00 cover price.

Back cover: TSR Forgotten Realms Black Wizards (Douglas Niles) ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear; light edge wear and a small spot on the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
